product.name: Credit Scoring
product.description: A service that evaluates an individual's creditworthiness using various personal and financial data points.

product.name: Account Aggregation
product.description: A service that consolidates financial data from multiple accounts into a single view for easier management and analysis.

product.name: Income Verification
product.description: A service that verifies an individual's income by accessing and validating financial records and data sources.

product.name: Identity Verification
product.description: A service that confirms the identity of individuals by validating personal information against trusted data sources.

product.name: Recurring Payments and Subscriptions
product.description: A service that manages automated recurring payment processing and subscription billing for customers.
